svg.title: Four-layer analysis pipeline, data ingestion through briefing
svg.desc: Layer 1 (Data Ingestion): Ticker universes, US market data, Bursa / KLSE, Historical replay, Analysis Store. Layer 1.5 (Input Isolation): Sealed run input. Layer 2 (Analyst Agents, Haiku): Fundamentals, Sentiment, Technical, Macro / FX. Layer 3 (Adversarial Debate, Opus): Bull researcher, Bear researcher. Layer 3.5 (Research Manager, Sonnet): ResearchManager. Supporting context (Outcome Memory): Outcome Memory. Layer 4 (Synthesis, Sonnet): SynthesizerAgent, Consensus + actionability, RiskChecker. Layer 5 (Portfolio Research): Run-bound allocator, Nine target-weight views, Forward cohort collector. Output: Briefing, consumed by Next.js screener, FastAPI, Backtester.

g.text: Layer 1 · Data Ingestion — Deterministic inputs — no LLM
Layer 1.5 · Input Isolation — Deterministic evidence preparation
Layer 2 · Analyst Agents — four concurrent analysts
Layer 3 · Adversarial Debate — 3 rounds by default
Supporting context · Outcome Memory — optional · resolved exits only
Layer 4 · Synthesis — synthesis then deterministic risk
Layer 5 · Portfolio Research — optional completed-run batch · deterministic · US/USD
fixed sleeves · rejected signals keep cash
